generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
List of Financial Resources with Certificates

The tender should have executed in any one year the following minimum quantities of works usually 80% of the annual requirement of RCC NP3 Class pipes 300mm dia and above- 387 Rmt, Glazed Stone ware pipes of 230mm dia and above-372 Rmt . MH-1.2m dia 1m depth-31 Nos,
Contractors should have Civil contractor registration in BWSSB or KPWD/KUWSDB, etc
Form of tender is mandatory to upload in kppp portal.
Assessed available tender capacity is (AxNx2.5-B) should be greater than Rs.70.90Lakhs
Qualification Information of clause 1.3(A) &(B) are mandatory.

The Tenderer Should have a in the last 5 years period achieved in at least two financial years an average turnover of not less than estimated cost of the respective works (Profit & loss account, Balance sheet certified/Audited by chartered accountant)..i.e.,Rs.70.90Lakhs
The Tenderer should have satisfactorily completed one similar work to an extent of 50% of the cost of the respective works. i.e.,Rs. 35.45 Lakhs.
Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities usually 30% of the amount of contract i.e., Rs. 21.27 Lakhs.

The successful bidder would be required to give performance bank guarantee of 5% the contract amount plus additional security for unbalanced bid amount from Nationalized / Scheduled Indian Bank, with jurisdiction at Bangalore as specified towards guarantee for completion of work within the stipulated period.
